_doc: Atlas layout. Owner: Animations. One source for the Godot bake (tools/bake), the phone bake (src/render/commander_bake.js), the sprite player (src/render/units.js) and tools/timing_check.mjs. Columns are frames in clip order; rows are the baked directions.
_cell_doc: Fixed world scale for every fighter. footY: the ground point's line in the cell. bodyPx: on-screen height of a height-band 1.00 fighter (a Warrior), ground to top of head; the bake scales each model to band x refHeightM, so a Mage at 1.15 stands 92 px and Character Dev's bands survive into the sprite. Measured on the proof bake (2026-11-06, 180 px diagnostic cell): at the 44 deg camera the feet reach 13 px below the ground point standing still, because toes nearer the camera project lower; in a wide stance the foot nearer the camera sits lower on screen. footY 104 leaves 16 px for it and 12 px above a Mage's hat (106 was 1 px short after rounding).
_directions_doc: Six headings from three rows. yawDeg turns the model from facing the camera toward screen right (45 front three-quarter, 90 side, 135 back three-quarter). The player mirrors a row horizontally for the matching left heading.
_camera_doc: pitchDeg: camera looks down 44 deg, measured from prototype/raid.html (camera height 1.12 x near distance: 48 deg to the near row, 40 to the far row). Arena owns the board camera and is asked to confirm.

budget._doc: Decoded memory, RGBA 4 bytes per pixel. Checked by tools/timing_check.mjs.
